name: project-seenta-monorepo
description: Project SEENta: Peer-to-Peer Lost and Found Management System for PUP Biñan Campus

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "yellow,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
